review.assessment: The change fully covers the stated scope. The task requires making `increment` thread-safe while preserving the public interface and keeping existing tests passing. The diff modifies only `solution.py`, introducing a `threading.Lock()` in `__init__` and wrapping both `increment` and `get` with it. This serializes all reads and writes to `self.value`, eliminating the race condition caused by the previous non-atomic read-modify-write sequence. No defects are present.
